maxConcurrentModels.name: Concurrent AI voice models
maxConcurrentModels.hint: How many character models stay loaded at once (speech routes to the selected character instantly). Each model uses ~2-4GB VRAM. Default 10, max 20; lower it on weak servers. Takes effect immediately.

aiSharedBase.name: Shared AI base URL (GM distributed)
aiSharedBase.hint: Filled automatically after GM shares; read-only for players.

aiSharedKey.name: Shared AI key (GM distributed)
aiSharedKey.hint: All players share the same key after GM distribution.

aiSharedModel.name: Shared AI model (GM distributed)
aiSharedModel.hint: All players use the same model after GM distribution.

portraitSize.name: Portrait Size
portraitSize.hint: Display size of portrait images in chat messages (up to 3x default)

portraitMode.name: Portrait display mode
portraitMode.hint: Message image = show the character portrait above the message; Indicator = show a small portrait beside the floatbar / chat input for the bound role; Both; None = disable.

voiceRunner.name: Voice Runner (whose PC runs TTS)
voiceRunner.hint: Self = run TTS locally; another player = your speech is synthesized by that PC (they must run the TTS service and broadcast it). Switching auto-updates the server URL.

aiPickAvatar.name: Chat Portrait: AI-pick role when unset
aiPickAvatar.hint: When a message has no speaking role, use AI to pick the best-matching character from the role list and show its portrait in chat. Off = only show portraits for roles.

enabled.name: Enable Module
enabled.hint: Master switch. When off, nothing is spoken and the status light hides.

engine.name: TTS Engine
engine.hint: GPT-SoVITS: local server synthesis (best voice; start server/start-tts-server.bat first). Web Speech: browser system voice (zero config, robotic, for testing/fallback).

serverUrl.name: TTS Server URL
serverUrl.hint: Default auto = use this machine at http://127.0.0.1:9881. For LAN multiplayer: other players' browsers must reach the machine (GM) running the TTS service, e.g. http://192.168.1.5:9881, and the GM must start the server bound to 0.0.0.0 so everyone hears the same voice.

voiceServerUrl.name: Voice Runner (Engine Machine) URL
voiceServerUrl.hint: World setting, GM-editable. Address of the machine running the TTS engine (leave empty = this Foundry host 127.0.0.1:9881). If you run FVTT on a different computer than the engine, enter the engine machine's reachable address, e.g. http://192.168.1.5:9881 or a public frp URL like http://frp-act.com:9881. ALL clients (GM/players) synthesize through the Foundry server which forwards to this machine — changing it transfers the voice-runner role to that machine.

voiceRunnerMap.name: Voice Generator Assignment (whose PC generates whose voice)
voiceRunnerMap.hint:
World setting, GM-only. No IPs needed — assign by player name: one line per entry "who speaks = generated by which player's PC"
Example:
PlayerXiaoMing = PlayerXiaoMing
PlayerXiaoHong = PlayerXiaoMing
(Above: XiaoMing's voice is generated on his own PC; XiaoHong's voice is also generated on XiaoMing's PC. Unlisted users / blank = default engine machine. The assigned player must run the TTS service (server/start-tts-server.bat) and be network-reachable from the FVTT server (same LAN usually works — the server auto-reads that player's online IP). Applies on the next spoken line, no restart needed.)

triggerMode.name: Trigger Mode
triggerMode.hint: send = speak on send; typing = speak after a pause while typing (no send needed); both = both (no duplicate when already spoken during typing); manual = only commands/macros/replay button.

speakSelf.name: Speak My Messages
speakSelf.hint: Disable to stop voicing your own messages.

speakOthers.name: Speak Others' Messages
speakOthers.hint: Disable to only hear your own (or the GM's) messages.

voiceFilter.name: Voice Source
voiceFilter.hint: all = everyone; gm = GM narration only; players = players only.

skipOoc.name: Skip OOC Messages
skipOoc.hint: Do not read out-of-character styled messages.

skipWhispers.name: Skip Whispers
skipWhispers.hint: When on, whispers are not spoken (off by default; only recipients can hear anyway).

skipRolls.name: Skip Rolls / Cards
skipRolls.hint: Do not read dice rolls and system-generated cards.

skipRich.name: Skip Rich HTML Messages
skipRich.hint: Messages containing HTML (item cards, macros) are not spoken by default; only plain text is voiced.

maxLength.name: Maximum Length
maxLength.hint: Longer text is truncated (keeps synthesis fast).

textLang.name: Reading Output Language
textLang.hint: The language used for reading (also the auto-translate target): Chinese / Japanese / English / Korean / Cantonese. With auto-translate on, messages are translated into this language and numbers are read in it (e.g. 12345 → 一万二千三百四十五 for zh); auto = guess from content.

queueMode.name: Playback Mode
queueMode.hint: queue = play in order; interrupt = new message cuts off the current one.

typingDebounce.name: Typing Pause (ms)
typingDebounce.hint: How long to wait after you stop typing before previewing.

showReplay.name: Replay Buttons
showReplay.hint: Volume button on each message to read it again.

showStatus.name: Status Light
showStatus.hint: Server status indicator in the chat bar (green = online, red = offline; click to test).

sttEnabled.name: Enable Dictation (Voice→Text)
sttEnabled.hint: Microphone button in the chat bar.

sttEngine.name: Dictation Engine
sttEngine.hint: browser = Web Speech API (Chrome/Edge, zero install); server = local server-side ASR (/asr: funasr for Chinese, faster-whisper multilingual, fully offline).

sttLang.name: Dictation Language
sttLang.hint: auto = guessed from the chat input content.

sttDevice.name: Microphone Device
sttDevice.hint: Pick the microphone for dictation. Grant mic access once (click the 🎤 button) before device names appear; device selection applies to server-side ASR, browser ASR always uses the system default.

hudTheme.name: HUD Theme
hudTheme.hint: Colors of the popups/floating bar: Dark = dark background with white text; Pink = pink background with deep-pink text.

sttAutoSend.name: Send Result Directly
sttAutoSend.hint: On: post the transcription straight to chat. Off: insert into the input box for you to confirm.

sttAutoSpeak.name: Auto-Read Dictation
sttAutoSpeak.hint: On: the transcribed text is immediately read aloud (speak → text → voice loop).

emotionSpeed.name: Emotion-Based Auto Speed
emotionSpeed.hint: On: reading speed follows the emotion's recommended value (angry fast / sleepy slow, etc.) to sharpen emotion contrast; manual per-voice speed still wins.

translate.name: Auto-translate reading language
translate.hint: On: when the reading language (e.g. Japanese) differs from the message text, translate before reading (numbers also converted to that language's reading). Uses MyMemory free API; falls back to the original text on failure.

voiceProfile.name: Voice Profile
voiceProfile.hint: Managed by the Voice Settings panel: character display name/avatar, emotion sample, reference audio, speed/volume. Use the Voice Settings button in the chat bar.

errors.synth: Synthesis failed. Make sure the TTS server is running (server/start-tts-server.bat); if you are a player without the server locally, ask the GM to read, or set the server address to the GM's LAN IP in Voice Settings
errors.synthStart: TTS service not connected (it may be starting/restarting — will auto-recover in about 1-2 minutes)
errors.sttDisabled: Dictation is disabled. Enable it in settings.
errors.sttNoSpeech: Browser heard nothing: check ①the dictation language matches what you say ②the system default mic is the one you want ③speak closer to the mic; consider switching to Server-side ASR (more reliable, and lets you pick the device)
errors.transFallback: Translation failed, reading in the original language
errors.sttDenied: Microphone permission denied: allow the mic in your browser and retry
errors.sttBrowser: Your browser does not support speech recognition. Use Chrome/Edge or switch to server-side ASR.
errors.sttServer: This browser cannot access the microphone.
errors.sttBrowserDevice: Browser ASR always uses the system default mic; to pick a device, switch the ASR engine to Server-side.
errors.sttSend: Failed to send the dictated message.

llmEnabled.name: Enable AI tone detection (LLM)
llmEnabled.hint: Optional: fill the key below and enable — the 'AI tone' button in the send panel judges the tone of your text via AI and applies it. Without it the module works as before with manual tone selection.

llmBaseUrl.name: LLM API base URL
llmBaseUrl.hint: OpenAI-compatible endpoint. e.g. OpenAI=https://api.openai.com/v1; DeepSeek=https://api.deepseek.com/v1; or any compatible service.

llmKey.name: LLM API key
llmKey.hint: Your model service key (used by this module only).

llmModel.name: LLM model
llmModel.hint: Model name, e.g. gpt-4o-mini / deepseek-chat. After pressing 'Fetch model list' in the voice settings panel, this becomes a dropdown of the service's available models.

llmPolish.name: AI polish lines
llmPolish.hint: On: after AI judges the tone, lightly polish the line per that emotion (interjections/expressions, same meaning) before speaking — replicating the reference app's tone variety; Off: speak the original text.

llmMergePolish.name: Merge judgement & polish
llmMergePolish.hint: On: one LLM call returns both the emotion and the polished line (halved latency, recommended); Off: two separate calls (judge, then polish).

llmModels.name: Fetched LLM models cache
llmModels.hint: Auto cache: models fetched by 'Fetch model list' in the voice settings panel (maintained automatically).

status.proxy: TTS via GM proxy (audio relayed by GM)
status.failHint: Click to test; if not started run server/start-tts-server.bat

gmMute.name: GM 全局静音(仅 GM 可操作)
gmMute.hint: 开启后所有玩家语音静音(停播+禁播); GM 悬浮条喇叭按钮一键切换

ui.mute: GM global mute (silence all players' voices)
ui.unmute: Global mute active - click to unmute
ui.styleTip: Reading style prompt: e.g. 'more serious, no pauses in the middle'. Mapped to speed/pause synthesis params, remembered per character.
ui.testPhrase: Hello! This is a voice test.
ui.langTip: Reading output language (also the auto-translate target)
ui.selfTest: Player self-test (verify this device can receive & play GM voice)
ui.cmdHint: Commands (lines starting with /) must be sent with Enter
ui.emotionMixTip: 0% pure default main ref; 100% emotion audio as the only ref; middle = main ref + emotion fusion
ui.emotionModTip: Modulate emotion via speech parameters: 0% no modulation; 100% full emotion speed (happy faster / sad slower)
ui.preloadedSendTip: Warmed up — click again to send
ui.preloadAudioDone: Audio ready — click again to play instantly
ui.polishNeedEmotion: Pick a tone first (e.g. happy/sad) to polish
ui.polishNeedAI: Enable “AI polish lines” in module settings first
ui.aiNeedText: Type something in the chat box first
ui.aiNoKey: AI not configured: fill API key and enable LLM in module settings, or choose tone manually
ui.quickChar: Quick character switch (local; GM syncs the server-active character)

vm.speedTestTitle: Batch speed test: synthesis/transfer/loading in batches, saturates GPU to verify peak performance
vm.selfTestPTitle: Player self-test: verify this device can receive & play GM voice
vm.gmMuteLabel: Mute everyone (no voice from any character)
vm.gmMuteHint: On: nobody hears speech instantly (chat portraits unaffected). Toggle off to restore.
vm.gmMuteNote: Global mute is controlled by the GM
vm.providerSaved: Voice engine saved, effective on next speech
vm.aiShareAll: Share AI config to all players
vm.aiSharedNote: AI config provided by GM (read-only, no need to fill)
vm.aiSharedOk: Shared to all players (world-scope, players read-only)
vm.aiSharedCleared: Revoked shared AI config (players fall back to local settings)
vm.stressTestTitle: Stress test: concurrency/long text/sequential synthesis/broadcast storm/bulk portraits
vm.selfTestTitle: Run all tests and write a report file for the author to diagnose
vm.voiceAssign: Voice Assignment (whose PC runs whose voice)
vm.voiceAssignHint: Assign a voice-running PC for each player; defaults to the GM's PC. Players follow automatically.
vm.title: Voice Settings
vm.runAssignTitle: Assign which account's PC generates whose voice (GM only)
vm.errServer: Cannot reach the TTS service: check the Voice Runner (Engine Machine) URL setting is correct and that machine has started server/start-tts-server.bat
vm.needModel: Model list is empty — put weights into engine fvtt_chars/models/ then refresh
vm.charNamePh: Leave empty to use the pack name
vm.emotionHint: Bind audio to each emotion slot in «Edit Character»; unbound slots use the main reference voice.
vm.gmOnly: Only the GM can manage characters (affects every client on this server)
vm.langHint: Language used for reading; auto = guess from content.
vm.aiHint2: Fill the API base URL and key here; models are auto-detected after typing. Without it, TTS works as before.
vm.aiSaveHint: Fill then press save to enable
vm.aiReady: AI ready! Go to the chat input → send panel → 🎯 AI Direct, no need to preload again
vm.aiNoKey2: Fill API base URL and key first

vm.mainRefHint: Select multiple clips at once: the first is the main reference, the rest are auto-bound to emotion slots (one per slot, adjustable later)
vm.newHint: Base model = built-in voice cloned with your reference audio; Model library = custom weights. After creation, bind one clip to each of the 10 emotion slots in «Edit Character».
vm.needRef: Please upload the main reference audio first
vm.slotHint: Each bound slot uses that clip's timbre; unbound slots use the main reference. Clips are auto-transcribed after upload.
vm.slotAvatarPh: Emotion portrait URL (chat avatar switches with tone)
vm.refTooShort: Clip too short for strong emotion; 3–10s recommended
vm.samplesHint: Built-in reference clips: preview, then bind one to any emotion slot (transcribed text is attached automatically).

runAssign.title: Voice Generator Assignment (whose PC generates whose voice)
runAssign.open: Open Voice Generator Assignment (list all accounts)…
runAssign.empty: ⚠ Could not retrieve the account list. Please check: ① the FVTT server has been restarted (the server script added an account channel); ② hard-refresh the browser. If still empty, screenshot this and send to the author.
runAssign.emptyShort: Account list empty (restart FVTT and refresh)
runAssign.hint2: All accounts (including offline players) are listed — the GM picks whose PC generates each account's voice. Offline accounts can be assigned in advance (applies when they log in). The assigned account must run the TTS service and be reachable from the FVTT server (the server auto-reads that account's IP). Players cannot adjust this themselves.
runAssign.hint: Each account's voice is generated by the selected account's PC (that account must run the TTS service and be network-reachable from the FVTT server — the server auto-reads that account's PC IP). Unassigned = default engine machine. All accounts (including the GM) can be assigned; players cannot adjust this themselves.
runAssign.deny: Only the GM can modify voice generator assignment. Current assignment:
runAssign.saved: Saved — applies on the next spoken line
